title: orbitopt two-stage LEO reference mission config v1.0
description: A user-editable YAML/JSON config for the frozen two-stage LEO reference scenario of task #225 (M-07): `Launch Site -> Liftoff -> MECO -> Separation -> SECO -> Parking Orbit -> Orbit Propagation` with a continuity + mass-conservation gate at every handoff and one unified task report. The whole mission lives under `scenario` (the same document `orbitopt.mission.two_stage_leo.TwoStageLeoScenario.to_dict` writes, so a scenario file round-trips through `load_scenario`); `orbitopt.mission.two_stage_leo.build_from_config` runs it through the unified pipeline. Strict by convention: `additionalProperties: false` everywhere, every key is documented, nothing is silently defaulted at the schema level (defaults live in the dataclasses, and the loader re-validates what the schema cannot express, e.g. `run_dir` mode needing `ascent.run_dir`).

schemaVersion.description: Which version of this mission-config schema the document was written against.

id.description: Stable slug for the produced scene, e.g. 'm07-two-stage-leo'.

out_dir.description: Where the mission writes its artifacts (mission.verification.json, orbit_propagation.verification.json, launch/ in optimize mode). Default: next to the scene as <scene stem>.m07.

scenario.description: The frozen scenario: what to fly (launch), how to fly it (ascent), the handoff gates (handoff), the propagation plan (propagation) and the expected results with their tolerances (expected).

launch.description: The M-04 launch-pipeline inputs: site catalog name, vehicle (catalog name or path), orbit spec ('400x400@51.6', km altitudes) and the liftoff date. `raan_deg: null` (default) leaves RAAN unconstrained.

ascent.description: `optimize` flies the ascent now through the M-04 pipeline (needs the pinned OpenTsiolkovsky binary and pygmo); `run_dir` replays a previously flown FlightResult directory (`run_dir`) -- what a machine without the compute stack, or a regression test, uses. `target_file` is an optional FlightTarget copy to archive next to the report.

handoff.description: The M-01 continuity/mass gates used at every handoff of the chain, the staging separation-impulse headroom, and the M-02 element-agreement tolerances.

propagation.description: The frozen M-05 force model and arc: J2 on by default, optional drag (Cd/mass/area/exponent density model) and third bodies.

drag.description: orbitopt.mission.propagation.DragConfig (exponential atmosphere, constant Cd); null = no drag.

expected.description: What the mission must produce. `events` is the required station chain (all four links, in order). `parking_orbit`/`tolerances` override the values derived from `launch.orbit` plus the Gate-B insertion-tolerance defaults key by key -- the report records which is which under `inputs.expected_basis`. `propagation_result` is the required tri-state of the M-05 report.

scene.description: Scene-export rendering knobs (M-06 run importer), same vocabulary as the flight-lab kind.

elements.description: Classical orbital elements (SI; angles in deg) -- `raan_deg: null` means 'not constrained / not graded'.
